verdict.rationale: The pack does not document tenant isolation: no subaccounts, and no per-domain or per-tenant credentials, suppression lists, or reputation separation. The closest items are team-member access roles and an MCP tool list that mentions managing domains, suppressions and users. Both are adjacent features and do not show isolation between tenants.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can isolate tenants — subaccounts, subusers, or multiple domains with separate credentials, suppression lists, and reputation — for the platform I'm building
